partial_conditions: One chain-side transaction, receipt, block, or exact-block SpokePool log is unavailable
The destination event is observed but the composite Across domain cannot be reconstructed
failed_conditions: The same deposit ID from another origin chain or SpokePool is paired
A common event parameter or integer amount differs between chain sides
Explorer interpretation is promoted without raw provider replay

requirements.description: The Base V3FundsDeposited candidate must preserve chain, SpokePool, transaction, deposit ID, recipient, assets, and raw amounts.
The Ethereum FilledV3Relay candidate must preserve the matching origin chain, deposit ID, recipient, destination token, and output amount.
Matching must use the official Across V3 event rules and chain-separated composite domain, never deposit ID or amount-time alone.
